found.truth_sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(addMonths(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'America/New_York'), 1)) AS m, sumOrNull(o.amount) AS v FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE 1 GROUP BY m HAVING m >= toDate('2025-01-15') AND m < toDate('2025-03-01') SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
